name: reva
description: Read your vacation rental reviews, ratings, units, listings and reservations from Reva.

interface.longDescription: Reva collects guest reviews for vacation rental companies from Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Google and their own sites. Connect Reva to ask about your reviews in plain language: average ratings by channel, month or property, your worst-rated units and what guests complain about, reviews still waiting for a reply, trending positive and negative topics, staff performance from cleans and inspections, and the listing links of every unit. Every tool is read-only and shows only the companies and properties your Reva user can see.
defaultPrompt: Which of my units have the lowest rating this year?
Which reviews from the last 2 weeks have no reply?
Compare my Airbnb and Vrbo ratings by month

positive.description: Lists the companies the user can read.
positive.prompt: Which companies can you see in my Reva account?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_companies and lists the demo company by name.

positive.description: Compares the average rating on two channels.
positive.prompt: What is my average rating on Airbnb compared with Vrbo this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the company and its channels, then reports the review count and average rating for Airbnb and for Vrbo this year.

positive.description: Finds reviews that have no host reply.
positive.prompt: Show me the 5 most recent reviews that nobody replied to yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_reviews with host_response false and shows the 5 newest unanswered reviews with their rating, channel and text.

positive.description: Ranks units from worst to best rating.
positive.prompt: Rank my 10 worst-rated units over the last 12 months.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_unit_ratings worst-first for the last 12 months and lists 10 units with their average rating and review count.

positive.prompt: How many reviews mentioned cleanliness in the last 3 months, and what was their average rating?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_review_stats with the cleanliness tags or phrases and a 3-month date range, then reports the count and the average rating.

negative.description: Posting a reply is a write. Every Reva tool is read-only, so the assistant can draft a reply but must say it cannot post it.
negative.prompt: Reply to my latest 1-star review on Airbnb for me.

negative.description: Deleting reviews is a write and is not possible. The assistant must say Reva cannot delete or change reviews.
negative.prompt: Delete all the negative reviews from my Vrbo listings.

negative.description: The question has nothing to do with vacation rental reviews, so no Reva tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Miami this weekend?

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only access to reviews, ratings, units, listings, staff performance and reservations.
